text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - The Shanghai stock exchange will make improving services and strengthening supervision the key tasks for this year.
- A shortage of accountants is causing delays in the issue of 1996 listed firm results, with the number of listed firms up and auditing requirements now more strict.

- Shanghai is ready for the redemption of matured state debt with over 1,300 redemption outlets set up by banks and other financial institutions around the city. China faces a redemption peak this year with over 120 billion yuan worth in state debt maturing.
- BUSINESS NEWS - Production of import substitute products will become one of China's new economic growth areas.
- Dai Xianglong, governor of the People's Bank, the central bank, says China's inflation will be under six percent in 1997.
